_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2013 10-K); 'Newer services and technologies that may compete with our video services include digital distribution services and devices that offer Internet video streaming and downloading of movies, television shows and other video programming that can be viewed on television sets and computers, as well as other devices such as smartphones and tablets'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2013 10-K); 'Newer services and technologies that may compete with our video services include digital distribution services and devices that offer Internet video streaming and downloading of movies, television shows and other video programming that can be viewed on television sets and computers, as well as other devices such as smartphones and tablets'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.25x; +39% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.09; conservative 2yr +7%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.9%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (FY04-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2014-03-07) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.25x (47.7% downside to Bear $27 / +190.5% upside to Bull $150) | Adj composite 1.76 vs market 1.67: gap +0.09 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +39% above the EPP floor $37 (15x FY14E $2.47) | Conservative 2-yr case: +7.4% total (+3.7%/yr) | At 20.9x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $68 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; video subscribers -1.4% in Q4 2013, forward revenues +6.2% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2013 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
